verdict.rationale: Brex documents an Accounting API for viewing/managing accounting data, GL coding automation, and webhooks for real-time sync, which directly supports automated syncing of transactions/expenses to accounting software. However, there's no explicit mention of specific accounting software integrations (QuickBooks, NetSuite, Xero) or independent confirmation the sync works reliably in practice. missing for 10: named third-party accounting platform integrations, independent/hands-on verification of sync accuracy and reliability, detail on sync frequency/error handling.
